💡 Why gno.land? 
gno.land brings deterministic, composable smart contracts in Go with transparent, community-driven governance. As a statistician specializing in optimization and distributed systems, this developer-first culture aligns with our data-driven, high-availability approach to infrastructure.

🛠️ Contributions & Plans

Infrastructure: Enterprise bare-metal servers, firewalled P2P access, key-based SSH only.
Ecosystem Support: Planning public RPC/API endpoints and fast state-sync snapshots.
Governance: Active, data-backed participation in on-chain governance.
